options.explanation: Present tense 'is' is incorrect; it should be past tense 'was'.

options.text: He said that I was happy.
options.explanation: Pronoun 'I' is incorrect; it should be 'he' to match the subject.

options.text: He said that he was happy.
options.explanation: Correct tense change and pronoun adjustment.

options.text: He says that he was happy.
options.explanation: Reporting verb 'says' is incorrect; it should be 'said' to match the direct speech.

questions.explanation: In Indirect Speech, the present tense 'am' changes to past tense 'was'. The pronoun 'I' changes to 'he' to match the subject of the reporting verb.
questions.hint: Focus on the tense change from direct to indirect speech and pronoun adjustment.
